key: must:E27b:Deliverable is the original office video with added audible music, not just an audio file
symptom: Deliverable is the original office video with added audible music, not just an audio file

whys.why: Why was the deliverable not the office video with music added?
whys.because: In both chats the assistant only made a separate music track and returned a WAV link. The original talk-two.mp4 was never changed or sent back.
whys.evidence: s3.new.happy.E27b/calls.jsonl and s3.old.stupid.E27b/calls.jsonl: the only paid call is generate_music (duration 15, instrumental), then wait_for_audio_project, which returns output.wav. grade.json: 'a video was made' failed with got [".wav"], and the must-have was not met: 'Only a 15 s WAV link was delivered; the user must mix it themselves.'

whys.why: Why did the assistant stop at the audio file and not put it on the clip?
whys.because: The assistant decided before doing any work that no tool could mix music under an existing video, and it told the user so. Its plan was a track that the user adds in CapCut or iMovie.
whys.evidence: new state/calls line 5: 'none of the tools I have can mix music under an existing video and leave the clip and its conversation untouched… The tools that do touch your video would all replace its audio or re-generate the clip, so I won't use them here.' old calls line 4: 'none of my Magic Hour tools can mix a music track into an existing video'. Final old message: 'I can't merge the track into the video for you.'

whys.why: Why did it conclude that no tool could do the mix?
whys.because: The assistant read the tool list correctly. No exposed tool takes a user video plus an audio file and returns the video with the audio mixed in. edit_video regenerates content from a prompt. translate_video replaces the speech. join_videos only joins videos end to end, with a 'silent' option. create_talking_photo needs a still image.
whys.evidence: tools-new.json: edit_video 'Edits the appearance or content… using a text prompt'; translate_video 'Translates speech'; join_videos 'Join videos end to end with hard cuts… silent: remove all sound'; get_last_frame and trim_video do no audio work. tools-old.json has the same Magic Hour API tools and none of the production tools.

whys.why: Why does the new build, which can mix music, still not cover this case?
whys.because: The new build's mixer only runs inside the production pipeline. join_production_clips 'mixes the music under' the narration, but only for clips made by create_production_clip from a plan_video_production plan. A plan's references are pictures or last frames, not a user video. So the user's existing clip cannot get to the mixer.
whys.evidence: tools-new.json: join_production_clips 'Joins the finished clips of a plan… If the plan has sound, pass sound… mixes the music under it'; create_production_clip 'Makes one clip of a plan'; plan_video_production reference.kind enum is none/picture/last_frame/file, where file is 'a picture you made or were given'.

whys.why: Why is there no such tool at all?
whys.because: The server's tool set, in both the hosted build and the upgraded build, has no general 'add or mix an audio track onto a supplied video' operation. The upstream Magic Hour API tools exposed through MCP have none either. This is a gap in what the MCP server offers. The brief and the free plan are not the cause: the test expects beyond_free 'no', and generate_music worked on the free plan.
whys.evidence: E27b.json: expect.beyond_free 'no', and must_haves[0] requires 'the original office video with an added audible music track'. Both tool lists have no tool whose description mentions adding audio to an existing video.

result.axiom: Neither build exposes a tool that mixes a generated or supplied audio track under the existing audio of a user's video. The only mixer, in the new build's join_production_clips, works only on clips generated from a production plan. So the assistant correctly said it could not do the task and delivered only the WAV.
result.fix: Add a server-side tool, add_audio_to_video(video, audio, music_gain_db≈-18, keep_original_audio=true, fit='trim_to_video', fade_out_s=1), that runs ffmpeg like join_videos does and returns the download URL of the mixed MP4. Reuse the mixer from join_production_clips. Describe the tool in generate_music's description too ('to put this music on the user's clip, call add_audio_to_video') so that the assistant chains the two calls and does not stop at the WAV.
